title: Among cards illustrated by John Avon that lack powerful foil identifiers (i
question: Among cards illustrated by John Avon that lack powerful foil identifiers (i.e., either cardKingdomId or cardKingdomFoilId is NULL), identify those that are banned in the format with the highest total number of banned cards. Return the card names and their associated ban format.

prediction.sql:
WITH MaxBanned AS (
    SELECT "XCL_084" AS format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned
    FROM legalities
    WHERE "XCL_085" = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY "XCL_084"
    ORDER BY count_banned DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    c."XCL_049" AS card_name,
    l."XCL_084" AS ban_format
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON c."XCL_072" = l."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN MaxBanned AS mb ON l."XCL_084" = mb.format
WHERE 
    c."XCL_002" = 'John Avon'
    AND (c."XCL_006" IS NULL OR c."XCL_007" IS NULL)
    AND l."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
